description: This file defines the `PingService` class, an Android `IntentService` responsible for creating and managing notifications with snooze and dismiss actions. It handles intents with specific actions to show notifications, snooze, or dismiss them, and manages the notification lifecycle including timing and user interaction.

classes.name: PingService
classes.description: An Android `IntentService` that displays notifications with snooze and dismiss actions, handles timer-based notifications, and manages user interactions with notifications.

methods.name: PingService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IntentService with a specific name for its worker thread.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents to process notification actions such as pinging, snoozing, or dismissing.

methods.name: issueNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays a notification with snooze and dismiss actions, and a pending intent to launch ResultActivity on click.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Starts a background thread to wait for the specified milliseconds before issuing a notification.
